purpose: Teach: ジュン/純一郎/愛子/めぐみ/幸子/直樹/哲也/ディック

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスのジュンくんと仲良いな
lines.en: Hey Riku — you're pretty friendly with Jun from the class next door, huh.
lines.style: Light, teasing lilt. Eyes narrowed with playful observation. Casual lean. Not accusatory — genuinely curious about what she's spotted.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で小泉純一郎元首相の郵政改革習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You studied Koizumi's postal reform in social studies, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflection masked as agreement. Quick, almost evasive. Doesn't land on the question — redirects sideways. Slight defensive edge under the surface politeness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、皇室の愛子様のニュース観てたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you watching the news about Princess Aiko the other day.
lines.style: Sarcastic turn-around. Knowing half-smile. Matching his deflection back at him with the same 'I noticed something about you' energy. Playful turnabout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、めぐみちゃんと文化祭で一緒だったろ、桜
lines.en: You were partnered with Megumi for the cultural festival, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Same deflection rhythm, faster now. Tit-for-tat. The tone has a slight smile underneath — he's playing her game, not fighting it. Deliberate echo of her rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお母様、幸子さんって名前だったよな
lines.en: Riku — your mom's name is Sachiko, right.
lines.style: Escalation. Voice sharpens slightly. Still teasing but with a thread of 'I know more than you think I do.' Testing whether he'll actually engage or keep dodging.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お兄さん直樹さんとサッカーしてたな、桜
lines.en: You used to play soccer with your older brother Naoki, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Sustained deflection but with growing awareness that she's onto him. Quieter now, less rhythmic. There's a crack — he's running out of conversational ammo but won't admit to noticing her noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、転校生の哲也と仲良くなったな
lines.en: Riku — you got pretty close with Tetsuya, the transfer student.
lines.style: Final push. Direct, gentler. The teasing has dropped away — she's asking something real underneath the game. Open-faced. Waiting for him to actually answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ディック・グレイソンってバットマンの相棒知ってるよな、桜
lines.en: You know Dick Grayson, Batman's sidekick, right, Sakura.
lines.style: Surrender disguised as absurdity. Dry, almost defeated laugh in the delivery. Completely random topic — he's given up the deflection game and thrown a curveball instead. Wry acceptance of being caught.
